answer_1.quote: Summarization techniques can be broadly classified into two categories: (i) Extractive, and (ii) Abstractive.

answer_2.quote: We measure the performance in terms of Rouge-L. Rouge-L assesses the syntactic and semantic similarity between the generated and the gold coherent summary, indicating their proximity.

answer_3.quote: Evaluation using G-Eval ... Specifically, we utilized the coherence metric from G-Eval ... we used a similar implementation to G-Eval with a 'GPT-4o' version.

answer_4.quote: We asked three independent human evaluators (graduate student volunteers) to assess the summaries (50 randomly selected from the test set).
answer_4.guideline: Each evaluator was asked to choose their preferred summary from three options ... and ... rate each summary's coherence on a Likert scale ranging from 1 (incoherent) to 5 (perfectly coherent).
